decisions.reason: The 15-day express program sits close to the core offer and stays visible on the website, so the results appear satisfactory, and a large firm in a growing industry has the slack to carry a low-cost service offering.

The 72-hour express program is still mentioned and fits the firm's promise of fast response, so there is no visible shortfall that would trigger search for other uses, although its logistics are more demanding than the 15-day program.
This multi-model express line has kept a page of its own in both years, which signals results at or above aspiration and its place as an established part of the portfolio.
The online ordering and digital services platform keeps its own page and supports the strategy of deeper service for trade partners, so continued investment is likely given the firm's slack.

The fire and smoke protection door moved from a mention to a page of its own in 2024, which suggests results exceeding aspiration, and it probably took over the role of the dropped fire-resistant door C.
